t: r/AskAnAmerican on Reddit: Where you guys buy house goods (Decor, kitchen, bath, furnitures etc)?
s: March 7, 2025 - But for art/plushies/really unique stuff, for that we try to buy from the seller's main site/in-person and not via etsy or whatnot. I assume they make more profit this way. ... Target and IKEA. Walmart terrifies me. ... My furniture is from Macy's, Room & Board, Kasala, and a store in Seattle that sold top quality locally made solid hardwood furniture for pretty reasonable prices and which sadly is no longer in business. Smaller items from a lot of different places, such as Costco, Ikea, Target, Home Goods, Etsy, local lamp stores, Fred Meyer, and more places I don't remember.
